ios.desc:
Grateful Me is a private gratitude journal with prompts and guided 14-step paths. Every word stays on your phone: no account, no cloud, no AI.

TWO WAYS TO WRITE
• Your own way: open the app when something good happens and write it down. No plan, no deadlines. Short of an idea? The app offers a prompt from the areas of life you care about, and "Change prompt" gives you another.
• Guided: choose a path, a named series of 14 questions the app walks you through one step at a time. Each answer is an ordinary journal entry. After steps 7 and 14 the path pauses for a reflection: you read your own answers and see what keeps coming back.

SIX THEMES
More calm, Appreciate the everyday, Closer to people, Kindness toward yourself, Work without burning out, and Seasons. Each theme has seven cycles of 14 steps. Every new cycle asks about the same thing in new words, and its reflection sets each answer beside the one from the cycle before.

NO PRESSURE
A path is not a challenge. There is no end date, nothing resets, and a break spoils nothing. You set your reminders, and they sound like an invitation, not a reproach. The text of an entry never appears in a notification.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no cloud, no AI reading your entries. Lock the journal with Face ID.

FREE TO WRITE, FOREVER
Free: unlimited entries, your whole history to read, edit and search, life areas, the prompt pool, monthly stats, one reminder and Face ID. The first 7 steps of the first cycle of every theme are free too.

Premium adds the reflections: after steps 7 and 14 of a path, the full monthly summary and your Year of gratitude. It also unlocks steps 8–14 of every cycle and every cycle from the second on.

Premium is an auto-renewable subscription: yearly with a 7-day free trial, or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://gratefulme.byarcadia.app/terms/

quotes.text:
I built a gratitude journaling app that implements CBT techniques to help users develop a daily mindfulness practice. Research shows that consistent gratitude practice can significantly improve mental wellbeing, and I wanted to create a tool that makes this accessible.

The app focuses on these core principles:

- Privacy: All data stays on your device with an offline-first approach
- Simplicity: Clean interface optimized for quick daily entries
- Consistency: Streak tracking and gentle notifications to build a habit
- Organization: Category system to identify patterns in what brings you joy

Tech details:

- Built with React Native/Expo
- Local SQLite database using expo-sqlite and drizzle-orm
- In-app purchases via RevenueCat
- Minimalist architecture with a focus on performance

As a developer, the most valuable lessons came from handling the entire process solo - from initial concept through development to App Store submission and payment infrastructure.

The current roadmap includes customizable notifications, dark mode, and an achievements system.

Link: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6742772020

Any feedback or suggestions would be valuable for future iterations.
